title: Zetta-Joule split button
description: A 48px, 4px-radius button: a pale-blue square with a hairline return arrow beside an outlined label; or a single solid pale-blue button. On hover the label and square fill with the sky blue and the text turns white, over 0.2s.
notes: on a dark band, put the `dark` class on a parent so the outline turns white
name: zetta-joule-button

props.name: variant
props.description: split: a pale-blue arrow square plus an outlined label (default); solid: one pale-blue button

props.name: fullOnMobile
props.description: stretch to the full width on phones (the original does)
